name: DBMS Basics
description: Fundamental architecture, purpose, and advantages of database management systems over file processing systems.
learning_objective: Understand DBMS architecture, data abstraction layers, and instance vs schema independence.

name: Relational Model
description: Structure of relational databases including relations, tuples, attributes, domains, and relational schema principles.
learning_objective: Model real-world data as relations, understand relational constraints, and distinguish schemas from relation states.

name: Keys
description: Identification of candidate keys, primary keys, superkeys, and foreign keys across relational tables.
learning_objective: Determine minimal superkeys, designate primary keys, and correctly identify foreign key relationships.

name: Integrity Constraints
description: Entity integrity, referential integrity, domain constraints, and check constraints.
learning_objective: Enforce entity and referential integrity and predict system behavior under cascade, set null, and restrict operations.

name: SQL Basics
description: Core SQL DDL/DML, including SELECT projections, WHERE filtering, aggregation, and GROUP BY / HAVING clauses.
learning_objective: Construct declarative SQL queries to retrieve, filter, and aggregate relational data correctly.

name: SQL Joins
description: Multi-table relational queries using INNER JOIN, LEFT/RIGHT OUTER JOIN, FULL JOIN, and CROSS JOIN.
learning_objective: Combine relations using appropriate join predicates while accounting for null-extension and join cardinality.

name: Functional Dependencies
description: Semantic dependencies between attribute sets, Armstrong's axioms, attribute closures, and minimal covers.
learning_objective: Compute attribute closures, verify whether an FD holds, and find candidate keys using functional dependencies.

name: Normalization (1NF-3NF)
description: Schema decomposition, normal forms (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF), lossless-join property, and dependency preservation.
learning_objective: Analyze relation schemas for update anomalies, determine normal form levels, and decompose into 3NF/BCNF.
